findings.title: Child task view shows the original WRONG verdicts next to a re-evaluated CORRECT state
findings.resolution: PracticeService.outcome shows TaskProgress.deciding (attempt 1 once it counts as correct, else the latest) and overlays the re-evaluated verdicts of a first play-through attempt (design decision 8). FlagQueueIT "the task screen shows the re-evaluated attempt 1 of a revealed task" and the extended "re-evaluation awards the missing XP" assert state, attemptNo and per-part verdicts.

findings.title: Flag queue listing does N+1 full task loads (all parts, specs converted) only to build an 80-char excerpt
findings.resolution: FlagQueue.list reads the prompts with one ContentCatalog.prompts (TaskStore.prompts, one SELECT id, prompt) and the attempts with one PracticeStore.attemptsById query; no per-report lookup (design decision 6). Covered by FlagQueueIT queue tests.

findings.title: Flag queue is unpaginated and makes 2 extra queries per report, while anyone on the LAN can create reports without logging in
findings.reason: The per-report queries are removed by the F02 fix (2dfbb77). Paging is not possible without a contract change: listReports in API 0.5.1 has no limit/offset and returns a plain array; contract changes are out of scope for this slice (contract impact: none). Limiting report creation is child-side practice-flow behaviour not in any store spec; the app runs for one child on a home LAN (NFR-2 binding). Recorded for the docs store as a possible follow-up.

findings.title: taskPromptExcerpt trims trailing whitespace before the ellipsis, which differs from design decision 6; the field has no store-spec requirement
findings.resolution: excerpt no longer trims: exactly the first 80 code points plus an ellipsis, as design decision 6 says. FlagQueueIT "a long prompt is cut to an excerpt" now covers a space at code point 80.

findings.title: Re-evaluation that cannot grade (shape mismatch / unreadable) returns the same 200 changed=false as 'still wrong'
findings.reason: ReevaluationResult in API 0.5.1 has no reason field and the store spec scenario "Attempt is unparseable under the new spec" requires exactly "reported as no change"; design decision 7 documents that an ungradable input is no change, and the frontend behaviour note says so. Adding a reason needs a contract change (out of scope).

findings.title: A replay re-evaluation only counts as better when the whole attempt becomes correct; a per-part improvement is not covered by the spec
findings.resolution: Design decision 8 now defines "better" for a replay attempt as correct as a whole; ReevaluationRulesTest "a replay attempt counts as better only when it becomes correct as a whole" covers a two-part attempt with one part fixed (NoChange, also for a primary attempt). Clarifying the store-spec wording is noted for the docs store.

findings.title: The 'Rank-up from a re-evaluation' scenario is only partly tested: the 'celebration plays once' half is not asserted
findings.resolution: FlagQueueIT "a rank-up from a re-evaluation waits for HQ" now acknowledges the rank-up and asserts that pendingRankUp is null on the next HQ read while the rank stays 1.

findings.title: Task 5.2 (openspec validate --strict) is ticked with no recorded evidence
findings.resolution: Evidence: the pre-commit hooks of 9c24960 and 2dfbb77 ran `npx openspec validate --all --strict` (8 passed, incl. change/implement-progress-stats-api), and qa:verify re-runs it; tasks.md 5.2 now names that evidence.
